name: W Hotel Edinburgh
positioning: W Edinburgh in the St James Quarter, spread across the new ribbon-wrapped Ribbon building, the Quarter House and a 1775 Georgian townhouse terrace, with a 360-degree rooftop deck and terraced suites
best_for: Travelers who want to choose between bold modern design and a historic Georgian townhouse
Suite guests who want a private terrace over the city
Music lovers drawn to DJ sessions and the Sound Suite

facts.text: The hotel is in the heart of Edinburgh's St James Quarter.
W Edinburgh comprises three distinct buildings, two new and one historic.
James Craig Walk has a private entrance and a dedicated W Insider concierge service.
Many of the premium suites, from Premier Suites to the W Suite and Penthouse, have private terraces with views of the city.
The Penthouse has a private sauna and an outdoor shower on its private terrace with views of Edinburgh Castle.
The W Suites have a round super-king-sized bed.
Castle View rooms look out over the historic landscape of Edinburgh.
AWAY Spa's treatment rooms are named Fire, Earth, Water and Air, and a double treatment room hosts couples retreats.
The Sound Suite is a space for music creation, recording sessions and cultural takeovers.
Sunset Sessions in the W Lounge feature DJs as day turns to night.
SUSHISAMBA serves Japanese, Brazilian and Peruvian cuisine.

highlights.text: The Ribbon Building is conceived as a bundle of coiled ribbons culminating in a pennant, with bronze-colored metal ribbons that nod to the festival city.
The rooftop W Deck offers 360-degree panoramic views of Edinburgh.
James Craig Walk is a historic Georgian townhouse terrace dating from 1775, with a stone facade, high ceilings and tall sash windows.
Suites have Georgian-style panelling, saltire-inspired wood flooring and artwork by Scottish photographer Jodie Mann.
The Penthouse on the 9th floor of the Ribbon building has a modern fireplace, a spacious dining room and a rock bar inspired by the city's volcanic beginnings.

considerations.text: The minimum age to check in is 18.
On-site parking is operated by St James Quarter, not by the hotel.
Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
